SELECT a.code_module 
FROM assessments a 
JOIN studentAssessment sa ON a.id_assessment = sa.id_assessment 
WHERE a.assessment_type IN ('CMA', 'TMA') AND sa.score IS NOT NULL 
GROUP BY a.code_module 
HAVING AVG(CASE WHEN a.assessment_type = 'CMA' THEN sa.score END) > AVG(CASE WHEN a.assessment_type = 'TMA' THEN sa.score END)
